RBA issued blunt warning ahead of next rate decision; IMF urges spending cuts as another hike looms
Recession odds for 2027 rising; 'four horsemen' macro risks flagged for global economy
Iron ore prices under pressure; LNG flows to Japan surging while East Coast gas supply tightens
Australian housing hits 'absurdly unaffordable' levels; ACCC moves against real estate monopoly
WA gold and copper-nickel exploration hits: Forrestania, Aurum, Dalaroo deliver positive prefeasibility/survey results
Alcoa priced $2.6bn acquisition notes; Qantas ground staff strike looms; Coles maintains elevated milk pricing
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland, signalling tech infrastructure buildout

sectors.trend: Iron ore under pressure ('roaches seethe'); gold and copper-nickel exploration positive in WA; Alcoa raises $2.6bn via acquisition notes
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from soft iron ore; gold names (WMC.AX, NGN.AX) and copper (STO.AX, NEM.AX) benefit from WA exploration hits; Alcoa (AA) leverage risk on $175m interest burden

sectors.trend: Big Four banks advanced on easing yields; Bendigo Bank (BEN.AX) cutting jobs in Adelaide; state governments face soaring interest costs
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX supported by rate-hike expectations and NIM expansion; BEN.AX under structural pressure; state fiscal stress may pressure sovereign-linked credit

sectors.trend: LNG flows to Japan surging while East Coast gas supply tightens; petrol price shock emerging; Victoria retreats from renewable transmission; coal policy under political attack
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX benefit from LNG demand; gas supply tightness supports Woodside/Santos; petrol shock feeds inflation; renewable pullback hurts CSP.AX, LEM.AX near-term

sectors.trend: Coles maintains elevated milk pricing post-farmer support removal; Qantas ground staff strike threatens; working holiday visa limits hit regional businesses
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs; QAN.AX operational risk from strike; regional retail (SGR.AX, IAG.AX) squeezed by labour shortages

sectors.trend: Housing 'absurdly unaffordable'; tenant relief emerging; ACCC targets real estate monopoly
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face regulatory risk from ACCC; tenant relief may compress rental yields; construction (WBC.AX, CGW.AX) pressured by affordability ceiling

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn datacentre in WA; ASX small-cap runners (Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan); AI adoption concerns
sectors.implications: Datacentre buildout supports infrastructure and power demand; small-cap momentum names show speculative activity; CSL.AX, WES.AX digital arms benefit from AI integration

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: blunt warning + IMF pressure signals further rate hikes, pressuring growth and housing
Commodity divergence: iron ore weak, gold/copper exploration positive, LNG strong, petrol shock
Fiscal stress: state interest costs soaring, IMF urging federal spending cuts
Housing affordability crisis deepening with regulatory intervention (ACCC)
Geopolitical oil risk from Middle East; China repositioning as safe haven
Labour market tightening via visa restrictions; industrial action risk (Qantas)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; favour rate-sensitive banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX) with NIM upside; reduce long-duration REIT exposure
Maintain defensive tilt: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX; reduce cyclical mining (FMG.AX) and construction exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / petrol price spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel exposure; favour energy producers (WDS.AX, SOL.AX) over transport/consumer (QAN.AX, SUG.AX)
Avoid property REITs and builders; monitor ACCC enforcement; favour tenant-friendly rental operators
Reduce exposure to state-linked infrastructure and utilities; monitor NT funding dispute
Monitor QAN.AX; limited index impact but consumer sentiment risk

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Big Four banks on rate-hike NIM expansion
opportunities.rationale: RBA hawkishness and IMF pressure support further hikes; banks benefit from widening NIMs; already advancing

opportunities.recommendation: Add WA gold and copper-nickel exploration names on positive survey results
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania, Aurum, Dalaroo hits signal resource upside; gold supported by safe-haven flows amid recession fears

opportunities.recommendation: Position in LNG/gas producers on East Coast supply tightness
opportunities.rationale: Japan LNG demand surging; domestic gas scarcity supports pricing; structural under-supply

opportunities.recommendation: Long-term tech infrastructure via Anthropic datacentre buildout
opportunities.rationale: $31bn WA datacentre signals sustained capex; power and infrastructure demand structural

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce long-duration REIT and property builder exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing unaffordability + ACCC regulatory threat + rate hikes compress valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim cyclical iron ore exposure; favour gold over base metals
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore under pressure; recession risk elevates gold's safe-haven bid

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge fuel-cost inflation via energy long / consumer short
defensive_moves.rationale: Petrol shock feeds CPI; consumer staples face margin squeeze

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly negative over next 1–3 months. RBA rate decision and IMF pressure create headwinds; bank strength and easing oil/yields provide partial offset. Volatility elevated. ^AXJO to test support on any RBA hawkish surprise.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Rising 2027 recession odds, housing affordability crisis, and state fiscal stress cap upside. Structural positives in LNG, gold, and tech infrastructure offer selective opportunities. ^AORD likely to underperform global peers unless RBA pivots.
key_catalysts: RBA rate decision (imminent) and subsequent guidance
IMF Article IV review / spending recommendations
Iron ore price trajectory and China demand signals
watch_list: RBA cash rate and statement (next meeting)
